I've written the review to `review.md` in that task directory. The verdict is **pass**, with five notes and no must-fix findings.

I judged this from `diff.patch` and `requirements.md` alone. I didn't look at the before and after shots, so the layout numbers (first-row y, footer height, gutters) are unchecked.

- **Not confirmed:** the new rule in `rail.css` that hides the end-of-page chips only applies if the AI page's class is `page--ai`. I found no literal `page--ai` in the source, so check the class on `/framework/ai/`.
- **Missing:** no module doc in the diff links to the report, and no card report either, which the brief asked for.
- **Sessions page:** the panel header is hidden and the "updated" time moved to the footer line.
- **Models page:** it now draws inside the fetch callback, which fixes the no-DOM-after-`await` trap. Provider counts print as plain text instead of raw JSON.

The Inbox and the rail staying when a card opens aren't touched by this diff, so the review marks them n/a.
